segments.name: Subsea Robotics
segments.description: Provides the world's largest fleet of work-class ROVs, ROV tooling, and survey and positioning services to offshore energy customers.
segments.evidence: Our Subsea Robotics segment consists of our work-class remotely operated vehicles ("ROVs"), survey services and ROV tooling businesses.

segments.name: Manufactured Products
segments.description: Manufactures subsea hardware such as umbilicals, control valves and connectors, and provides autonomous mobile robotic solutions to industrial markets.
segments.evidence: Our Manufactured Products segment provides distribution systems, such as production control umbilicals and connection systems made up of specialty subsea hardware, along with clamp connectors and subsea and topside control valves.

segments.name: Offshore Projects Group
products: drill pipe riser services and systems
segments.description: Provides vessel-based integrated subsea project services including installation, intervention, diving and decommissioning, principally in the U.S. Gulf and offshore Africa.
segments.evidence: Our Offshore Projects Group ("OPG") segment provides a broad portfolio of integrated subsea project capabilities and solutions.

segments.name: Integrity Management & Digital Solutions
segments.description: Provides asset integrity, inspection and nondestructive testing services plus software and digital solutions, mainly to oil and gas, power generation and petrochemical customers.
segments.evidence: Our Integrity Management & Digital Solutions ("IMDS") segment provides asset integrity management, corrosion management, inspection and nondestructive testing services, principally to customers in the oil and gas, power generation and petrochemical industries.

segments.name: Aerospace and Defense Technologies
products: repair and maintenance services on submarines and surface ships
segments.description: Provides engineering services and related manufacturing for defense and space exploration, principally to U.S. government agencies and their prime contractors.
segments.evidence: Our ADTech segment provides services and products, including engineering and related manufacturing in defense and space exploration activities, principally to U.S. government agencies and their prime contractors.

revenueModel.text: Energy customers, including oilfield service companies as subcontractors, pay under dayrate and competitive-bid contracts for ROVs, vessels, equipment and services, while the U.S. Government pays ADTech for engineering and manufacturing.
revenueModel.evidence: In connection with the services we perform in our Energy business, we generally seek contracts that compensate us on a dayrate basis.
